title: add-token-stream-fidelity-metrics-and-alert-age-decay-policy
author: Asha Patel
description: Introduce a lightweight token stream fidelity metric plus a pragmatic alert age-decay suppression policy to reduce noisy fidelity alerts on transient downstream churn. This PR adds a Prometheus metric token_stream_fidelity{route,model,cohort} (histogram + gauge summary), enriches trace spans with fidelity_score and fidelity_reason tags for easier correlation, and ships a Grafana dashboard that correlates fidelity dips with per-token cost slope. The change is aimed at improving SRE's ability to quickly triage long-tail quality regressions while avoiding alert fatigue from short-lived backend variance. Changes include a sampling-based log enrichment path for fidelity dips, an alert rule that employs an exponential age-decay to reduce repeated firing for the same degradation window, and unit + e2e tests to validate metric shapes. Motivation: recent incidents highlighted noisy fidelity alerts during upstream model restarts; instead of raising thresholds globally, an age-decay suppression retains sensitivity to sustained regressions while muting flapping. Related Linear: ENG-1842. Checklist: 1) Add new metric and registry entry; 2) Enrich spans with fidelity tags; 3) Grafana dashboard + panels; 4) Alert rule with age-decay suppression; 5) Sampling for long-tail log enrichment; 6) Tests and CI. Notes: alert noise reduction is opt-in via feature flag obs.fidelity_age_decay_enabled=false until rollout is complete.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: The age-decay formula looks reasonable but please add a short diagram in the docs showing suppression over time for different half-lives.
Asha Patel: Added a visualization to docs and included table of example half-life values. Left config defaults conservative (1h half-life).
Riley Chen: Can we ensure the fidelity_score tag is low-cardinality? Suggest bucketing into low/medium/high in addition to raw score for indexability.
Asha Patel: Added fidelity_bucket (low|medium|high) and kept raw fidelity_score for local debug only; updated span_enricher and test coverage.
Sofia Adams: Alert rule LGTM but prefer feature flag default off until we monitor for 2 weeks in staging.
Asha Patel: Feature flag added and rollout plan described in the PR body; staging enabled for the team next week.
merge_summary: Merged after fixes to bucket cardinality and docs; CI green. Rollout gated behind obs.fidelity_age_decay_enabled feature flag. Deployed to staging on 2025-01-18 and to production after gradual monitoring window.
release_notes: Add token_stream_fidelity metric, trace enrichment with fidelity tags, new Token Stream Fidelity dashboard, and opt-in alert age-decay suppression to reduce noisy fidelity alerts. Metric and alert are behind feature flag.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag obs.fidelity_age_decay_enabled=false by default. To enable in staging set to true for monitoring. Observe prometheus:token_stream_fidelity:ratio and grafana dashboard 'Token Stream Fidelity and Cost Slope' for regressions. If alert suppression masks valid incidents, revert flag and open ENG-1842.
related_incidents: INC-2024-11 observed noisy fidelity alerts during model rolling restarts; this PR implements age-decay suppression as mitigation
testing_instructions: Run tests/e2e/token_fidelity_drift_test.py for simulated drift scenarios. Locally enable flag via pkg/config/feature_flags.go override and run ./scripts/local-observability.sh to spin up metrics + grafana mock. Verify fidelity_bucket tags present on sample spans.
